title: Squirreltopia
description:
WARNING: 

THIS IS A DIFFICULT SQUIRREL BASED 2D PLATFORMER.

ONLY SCROLL DOWN AND PROCEED IF YOU CAN HANDLE THAT.

 

THE EPIC TAIL SO FAR

A mysterious robotic squirrel - Shadow-tail, has kidnapped the squirrels and stolen all their gems and acorns. 

Defeat him and his powerful machines to take back planet Squirreltopia and prevent squirrel extinction!

SQUIRRELLY GAMEPLAY

Scurry across 50 levels and take control of a random squirrel each time. Every level is designed to have its own look and feel, and push squirrel physics to the limit. 

Addictive momentum-based gameplay 
♫ Full Original Soundtrack 
Insane Boss battles 
Play as a new Squirrel each level and every life! 
Cutting-edge squirrel tail physics! 
Explore the overworld and find entrances to new levels, play in any order! 
Mini-games, unlocked by finding retro game cartridges hidden in levels 
Scurry fast and try to earn the time trophies! 
Secret cheat items that can only be earned by the most skilled Squirrels! 
Can play with only 1 hand 

Do you have the squirrel skills to handle it?
